author: packs
description: Government services (X5-T1): licence and permit types and licences with review, inspection, issue, suspension, revocation and expiry stages; checklist review with decision reasons; fees; inspections; violations with objection and appeal; official correspondence numbered per Hijri or Gregorian year; committees and numbered decisions; benefit and grant cases. Roles for front desk, reviewer, inspector, approver, department head and auditor, report queries and a sidebar. Citizen requests and complaints use the service ticket.
name: government

definition.description: Reviews licence applications against the checklist.
definition.name: Government Reviewer

definition.description: Decides licences, objections and benefit cases.
definition.name: Government Approver

definition.description: Oversees the department and its committees.
definition.name: Government Department Head
Government: Licences by Status
definition.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS licences FROM gov_licence WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

definition.name: Government: Licences Expiring in 60 Days
definition.sql: SELECT id, licence_number, applicant_name, expires_on FROM gov_licence WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status = 'issued' AND expires_on < NOW() + INTERVAL '60 days' ORDER BY expires_on

definition.name: Government: Open Violations
definition.sql: SELECT id, violation_number, code, penalty_amount, issued_on, status FROM gov_violation WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('issued', 'objected', 'appealed') ORDER BY issued_on

definition.name: Government: Correspondence Awaiting Signature
definition.sql: SELECT id, reference_number, subject, direction, status FROM gov_correspondence WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status IN ('draft', 'review') ORDER BY created_at
